snippet.title: Cuphead meets Pokémon and Don’t Starve | KALIT Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Kalit is an experience developed by just 2 people with #UnrealEngine5.6 inspired by products like #Pokémon, Don't Starve and #Cuphead. It is an open world survival game with elements of creature collecting, made in rubber hose style ('30s) and with entirely hand-drawn animations. Explore a fantastic island, the underground and the seabed (and who knows what else).

In Kalit, the only limit is fantasy.


Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3789230/Kalit/
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/J2MeqUvFCe
